security_audit.summary: All 50 static alerts are false positives in documentation, including Markdown backticks, abbreviated API paths, and owner-only token storage. The shell examples can mishandle apostrophes when prompts are interpolated literally, despite claiming no injection surface. CLI implementation and remote service behavior were not available for verification.

remediation.issue: Prompt placeholders appear inside single-quoted shell JSON without an escaping procedure.
remediation.suggestion: Serialize input with a JSON library and pass it as one argument without a shell. Add tests containing apostrophes and shell metacharacters.

remediation.issue: The security guidance treats CLI JSON parsing as protection against shell interpretation.
remediation.suggestion: Explain that shell parsing happens before CLI processing. Replace the unconditional safety claim with explicit guidance for safe argument construction.

semantic_findings.title: Unsafe Prompt Interpolation in Shell Examples
semantic_findings.description: The Bash examples embed user prompts inside single-quoted JSON without shell-escaping guidance. Literal apostrophes can terminate quoting before CLI processing, contradicting the claim of no shell injection surface and enabling command injection if substituted directly.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented placeholders sit inside single-quoted shell arguments, which JSON escaping alone cannot protect. Exploitation depends on literal substitution; no CLI implementation was supplied.

content.value_statement: Short video generation requires clear motion prompts and valid model settings. This skill guides HappyHorse 1.0 requests through RunComfy with documented settings and audio direction.
actual_capabilities: Documents RunComfy CLI submission, status polling, cancellation, and output downloads for the HappyHorse text-to-video endpoint.
Defines prompt length, duration, resolution, aspect ratio, seed, and watermark settings.
Provides camera, motion, repeated character details, and audio directions for video prompts.
Includes default, vertical-video, and lower-resolution test invocation examples.
Explains account login, environment-token authentication, and common CLI exit codes.
Identifies alternative models for external-audio conditioning, reference inputs, and existing-footage editing.
limitations: Requires the external RunComfy CLI, a working account, network access, and provider billing.
Documents clips from 3 to 15 seconds, two resolutions, and five aspect ratios.
The documented endpoint accepts text only and does not accept images or external audio for lip synchronization.
Model quality claims and CLI security behavior are documented assertions, not independently verified guarantees.

prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare two three-second, 720P HappyHorse prompt variants for [scene] using the same seed. Change only camera direction and await approval before submission.

prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a 12-second, two-shot HappyHorse request for [story], repeating character details. Serialize inputs without shell interpolation, validate settings, and confirm billing before submission.

best_practices: Describe one clear action first, then add camera movement, timing, and audio direction.
Start with a three-second 720P test and reuse the seed when comparing prompt changes.
Pass serialized JSON without shell interpolation; approve provider billing and use a dedicated output directory.
anti_patterns: Paste arbitrary prompt text directly into single-quoted shell examples.
Request unsupported durations, aspect ratios, image inputs, or external-audio conditioning from this endpoint.
Combine conflicting visual styles and several unrelated actions in the first test clip.

faq.question: Does this skill generate videos locally?
faq.answer: No. It documents requests to the hosted RunComfy Model API through the local RunComfy CLI.

faq.question: What access is required?
faq.answer: You need the RunComfy CLI, a working account, network access, and provider billing. Authentication uses browser login or RUNCOMFY_TOKEN.

faq.question: Which video settings are documented?
faq.answer: Clips support 3 to 15 seconds at 720P or 1080P. Aspect ratios are 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, and 3:4.

faq.question: Can I provide images or an existing soundtrack?
faq.answer: Not through the documented text-to-video endpoint. Audio is generated within the video pass; reference-media workflows require a different endpoint or model.

faq.question: Which prompt languages are listed?
faq.answer: The skill lists Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, and French. Language support and output quality were not independently tested.

faq.question: Are the command examples safe for arbitrary prompt text?
faq.answer: Not with literal placeholder substitution. Use structured JSON serialization and direct argument passing so apostrophes cannot alter shell parsing.
